payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute prefix sums; build two Sparse Tables (min/max) via 2D DP; query prefix ranges before l and after r, adjust for skipped segment; merge intervals or take union to count distinct values.
payload.rationale: Sparse table construction uses DP recurrence on states (i,j) storing ranges of length 2^i, a textbook 2D DP preprocessing for O(1) RMQ. This aligns with dp_2d_state, with the DP table dimensions being log N × N.
